previous_root_cause_claim: setBalance(r.new_balance) with undefined value causing balance.toLocaleString() crash at next render.
previous_root_cause_status: INSUFFICIENT - mobile user confirmed crash still occurs on FIRST tap of FORGE SOUL.

timing_analysis.requestForge_only_sets: setConfirmOpen(true) and clears local UI state
timing_analysis.conclusion: Because the first tap NEVER touches /api/soul/forge nor mutates balance, the crash CANNOT be caused by setBalance(undefined). The previous diagnosis was wrong (or only a partial cause).

true_root_cause_corrected.description: The confirmation flow was implemented using React Native Modal wrapping a KeyboardAvoidingView wrapping a ScrollView, all rendered when setConfirmOpen(true). On Android/iOS native Modal + KeyboardAvoidingView + inner ScrollView interactions are a well-known source of layout/render crashes (especially with FadeInUp animations, dynamic content, and inputs). When the user taps FORGE SOUL the entire Modal subtree mounts — ANY render-time issue in the modal children (animated entering, TextInput inside KeyboardAvoidingView under a transparent Modal, computed style arrays, etc.) crashes the JS thread BEFORE any backend call happens.
supporting_evidence: Crash timing: tap FORGE SOUL -> crash. No /api/soul/forge call has happened yet.
Backend test via curl returns clean JSON {gained_essence,new_balance} — contract not implicated.
Previous defensive normalize/setBalance fix did NOT remove the crash, confirming the crash is upstream of any state update from server response.

Modal + KeyboardAvoidingView + nested ScrollView is a documented anti-pattern combination in React Native on Android, particularly when content includes Reanimated Animated.View entering animations and a TextInput.

fix_decision: Remove the React Native Modal-based confirmation entirely. Replace with an inline confirmation panel rendered inside the existing outer ScrollView (no Modal, no KeyboardAvoidingView in the confirm path).
residual_value_of_previous_pack: normalizeForgeResponse helper kept (defends against malformed responses)
snapshot heroIdsSnapshot kept (preserves heroes on failure)
backend contract verified correct - no backend changes
